  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.ibxsmartview.model used by com.eqixiac.equinix.ibxsmartview.client
    Class
    Description
    AssetDetail
    Asset details (including the asset's tag points) for a single asset, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope returned by the asset/details GET endpoint (AssetDetailsGetResponse in the spec).
    AssetDetailsResponse
    The multi-asset details returned by the asset/details POST endpoint, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope (AssetDetailsResponse in the spec).
    Assets
    The asset search results returned by the asset/search endpoint, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope (Assets in the spec).
    AssetsList
    The hierarchical (category / template / asset) assets list returned by the asset/list endpoint, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope (AssetsList in the spec).
    EnvironmentData
    Current environmental (temperature and humidity) data for a single hierarchy node, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope returned by the legacy /environment/v1/current endpoint.
    EnvironmentDataForArray
    A single environmental data entry within the payLoad.data array returned by the legacy /environment/v1/listCurrent endpoint.
    HierarchyNodeForAssetAPI
    The affected-customer-assets hierarchy (cage > cabinet > circuit) returned by the asset/tagpoint/affected-assets endpoint, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope (HierarchyNodeForAssetAPI in the spec).
    PowerAlertConfiguration
    Read-only model representing a power alert configuration returned by the IBX SmartView power-events API.
    PowerData
    Current power consumption data for a single hierarchy node, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope returned by the legacy /power/v1/current GET endpoint.
    PowerDataIBX
    A single power data entry within the payLoad.data array returned by the legacy /power/v1/current POST endpoint (PowerData_IBX in the spec).
    PowerEvent
    Read-only model representing a single IBX SmartView power event.
    SensorReading
     
    StreamingSubscription
    A streaming subscription (SubscriptionResponse in the spec).
    SubscriptionCertificate
    The certificate used to authenticate a streaming channel (SubscriptionCertificateResponse in the spec).
    SubscriptionData
    Near real-time subscription data retrieved via REST (SubscriptionData in the spec).
    SystemAlert
    A system alert raised by a monitored asset (AlertReadModel in the spec).
    TagPointData
    Current tag-point data for one or more tag identifiers, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope returned by the asset tag-point endpoints (TagPointData in the spec).
    TrendingEnvironmentData
    Trending environmental (temperature or humidity) time-series data for a hierarchy node, wrapped in the payLoad envelope returned by the legacy /environment/v1/trending endpoint.
    TrendingPowerData
    Trending power consumption time-series data for a hierarchy node, wrapped in the payLoad/status envelope returned by the legacy /power/v1/trending endpoint.
